You want to use the chart system? ok here the steps
--Audio--
First download a song and convert it to a wav or a mp3, ogg's dont work.
Place the audio file in backdrops and name it song
--Chart--
Press 0
Press flag
Press wasd or arrow keys to make a note
Wasd - Player
Arrow keys - Opponent
--Costumes--
Third step is costumes, You can make your own style of scratch for others to edit. idk what to put here since its really easy to do.
--Background--
This one is easy too, Just modify the backdrop called "Background" to whatever you want it to look like. You can make it animated too.
--Finish up--
Delete charter sprite and this sprite
--Honorable mentions--
If your chart isnt working, Reset the chart and then redo the chart.
--Thats all folks--
Thanks for reading this tutorial
